text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking through the academy with Meisho Doto when we hear King Halo's voice.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes! If you want a first-rate racer, then look no further than…

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: King Halo!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh wow… So that's the King Commendation…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: K-King carries herself so highly… She's really radiant…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Good day, Doto. And thank you for that intense gaze.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeek?! I'm s-s-sorry! I didn't mean to stare!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: There's no need to worry. Your intentions are loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You wish to recite the King Commendation with us! Do you not?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! W-wait, m-me?! I don't think I can. I-I'm sure I'll mess up…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Don't worry that head of yours! I'm granting you the right to learn directly from me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-you're willing to teach… someone like… me?! Huuuh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo begins her lesson amid Meisho Doto's confusion.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What's my name?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ki… King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The correct answer is "King"! It's important to keep your pronunciation curt and crisp.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ki… Kin… Kin-guh!

text_block_list.name: Almond-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: So close! It should actually sound like "King"! Try to say it clearly, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh, my apologies! I j-just can't seem to get it right!
choice_data_list: I suppose you do struggle with enunciating…
I suppose you do struggle with enunciating…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Then consider this your chance to overcome your nerves! Now, try and repeat my name until you get it right!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-but, I s-surely shouldn't waste any more of your time, King!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's fine. The three of us don't have anywhere to be, so take your time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I c-couldn't possibly do that! Um, I will practice on my own once I get home! A-a-apologies for all this!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Practice on your own? You…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Well, no, what I meant was… I'm sorry, so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I want to nail it in one go… If I do, maybe I'll become a little confident, just like you are, King… Ohh…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I like that you possess zeal. We will recite the King Commendation until you succeed!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wha… r-really?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: King… well, um… I pwomise to do my b-b-best!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-o-okay! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I shall have you practice with the other two! Perhaps their contributions will ease you into proper enunciation.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: G-got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto continues with her training well into the afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll go buy us all d-drinks, okay?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh no… I'm really s-sorry, but I don't have my wallet on me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Your carelessness is quite pronounced… No matter, I suppose this calls for thorough guidance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo's strict teachings resume after we take time out to relax and recover.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: K!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: K stands for kindling—a kindling fire of hope!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I!

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: I stands for incredible—incredibly first-rate! ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: N!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: N stands for noble—who nobly brandishes her talent!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: G!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: G stands for great! Because King Halo is great!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I applaud your quickness in mastering my new King Commendation!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, no… not at all… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Through practice, Meisho Doto succeeds in performing the new King Commendation.
